gate.description: One human gate: a question parked for the maintainer. Statuses owed/answered/waived/overtaken keep their 2026-09-14 meaning (#419 changes the store, not the semantics).

answer.description: The human's answer (answered), the waiver reason (waived), or what overtook it (overtaken; may stay null when the question body already records the overtaking events, as with the migrated G4). Null while owed.

answered.description: Date the answer/waiver/overtake was recorded (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD). Null while owed. Never precedes asked.

asked.description: Date the question was parked (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD).

blocking.description: Units/issues with no work until this gate resolves (refs as written, e.g. "#386"). Empty when the gate blocks nothing.

id.description: Stable gate id. Parked units cite it as "gate-batch.json G<n>" (pre-tooling refs say gate-batch.md; both forms resolve). Never renumbered: a renumber silently orphans citations.

question.description: The full ask, verbatim prose (may span lines). Rendered verbatim under the gate heading.

related.description: Related issues/PRs (refs as written, e.g. "#397"). Store-only: never rendered into the .md view.

status.description: owed: awaiting the human. answered: human replied (answer holds it). waived: human ruled no answer needed (answer holds the reason). overtaken: events resolved the question before the human replied (record only, no ask).

description: Run-close human-gate batch (#419). The JSON file is the store; gate-batch.md is a rendered view (gate-batch.py render regenerates it byte-for-byte when no gate carries answer text).

intro.description: Verbatim prose rendered between the header and the first gate (the batch's standing instructions).

resolved_by_events.description: Verbatim markdown block rendered under "## Resolved by events" (report-only items that were never asks). Empty string when there are none.

run_title.description: Human run name rendered in the header, e.g. 2026-09-14 clean-sweep tracker.

schema.description: Schema tag the CLI checks on load.

title: gate-batch
